comments.body:
🏷️ Label rationale
- `bug` — corrects Google embeddings that sent no retrieval task type, degrading asymmetric vector search quality.
- `skip-qa` — search-package code and tests only; no UI-rendering file, database structure and API surface unchanged, covered by unit tests that fail without the change.
- `priority-medium` — ordinary correctness bug fix.
- `risk-medium` — one provider path in a single package shipping with tests; other providers untouched.
- `merge-queue` — approved; `skip-qa` makes the QA-approval gate not applicable.
